pages.quiz:
MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.
   B. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Dance Production.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.

4. Best practice when working on Melody in Major Keys: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody in Major Keys.
   B. Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody in Major Keys.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody in Major Keys.

5. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.

6. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Western Style Solo Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Western Style Solo Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Western Style Solo Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Western Style Solo Songs.
   D. Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   B. Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   D. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

11. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

12. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software.
   C. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software.
   D. Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Western Style Solo Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instrument Indigenous musical instruments (fiddle, lyr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Red, blue, and yellow

2. D — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. B — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. B — Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. B — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. A — Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. D — Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. B — Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

11. D — The speed of the music

12. D — Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Western Style Solo Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instrument Indigenous musical instruments (fiddle, lyr; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
